offering_description.value: Manages outpatient MRI centers for medical practices and provides diagnostic scans to patients through its imaging network. Manufactures upright MRI scanners that image patients in multiple positions and sells and services the equipment for imaging providers.

primary_services.value: Outpatient imaging center management; diagnostic MRI scans; MRI equipment maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: Radiology practices, independent diagnostic imaging centers and hospitals; B2C: Patients referred for outpatient MRI scans

end_markets.value: Outpatient diagnostic imaging; radiology; hospital imaging

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Administrative and operational management of MRI centers; healthcare reimbursement: Diagnostic MRI scans billed to health insurers and other payers; service fees: MRI scanner maintenance and repairs; product sales: Upright MRI systems purchased by imaging providers
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; healthcare reimbursement; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Supplies staffing and administrative support to imaging practices and maintains scanners for equipment owners; asset operator: Runs MRI scanners at outpatient centers serving referred patients; OEM / manufacturer: Builds MRI systems from components for imaging centers and hospitals
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: Managed centers in New York and Florida, with MRI equipment installations in the United States and overseas

specialization.value: related lines: MRI center management, diagnostic scanning, scanner manufacturing and equipment service

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Managed outpatient imaging centers that receive physician referrals; direct sales: Equipment and service sales to imaging centers and hospitals

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA clearance for MRI systems and applicable state licensing and healthcare billing rules for imaging centers

notes: The current extent of overseas equipment sales is uncertain.
